craft_notes: Sthāyin: container-universalizer (pot-class → inside-me → all-pervading born). Rows: row 3 (never-born→contemplating thus). Close: thus (iti — the method-verb closes: contemplating THIS way, all-going). Rejected: 'projection' — killed: born kept (jātam — birth, not projection); 'pervasive already' — killed: never all-pervading BORN (the born is the claim).

lines: Pot and such, knowing, desire and such, inside me:
never all-pervading born — all-going contemplating thus.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ghaṭādau yac ca vijñānam icchādyaṃ vā mamāntare | naiva sarvagataṃ jātam bhāvayan iti sarvagaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is all-pervading born? → Contemplating all-pervading born-within, one becomes all-going.
